mapper.select: SELECT id::text FROM public.nw_tenants WHERE id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) FOR UPDATE
SELECT id::text FROM public.nw_tenants WHERE id>CAST(#{after} AS bigint) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT content FROM public.nw_chat_attachment_bodies WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND sha256=#{sha256} AND size=#{size} AND format='bytea.v1'

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT sum(size) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT sha256,size,body_format FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{session} AND body_format IS NOT NULL ) owned),0)::bigint AS session_bytes, COALESCE((SELECT sum(size) FROM public.nw_chat_attachment_bodies WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)),0)::bigint AS tenant_bytes, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{session} AND sha256=#{sha256} AND size=#{size} AND body_format='bytea.v1') AS in_session

SELECT COALESCE(sum(size),0)::bigint FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT sha256,size,body_format FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND session_id=#{session} AND body_format IS NOT NULL ) owned
SELECT COALESCE(sum(size),0)::bigint FROM public.nw_chat_attachment_bodies WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
mapper.delete: WITH unreferenced AS ( SELECT b.tenant_id,b.sha256,b.size,b.format FROM public.nw_chat_attachment_bodies b WHERE b.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_chat_session_attachments a WHERE a.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND a.sha256=b.sha256 AND a.size=b.size AND a.body_format=b.format) ORDER BY b.created_at,b.sha256,b.size LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF b SKIP LOCKED ) DELETE FROM public.nw_chat_attachment_bodies b USING unreferenced u WHERE (b.tenant_id,b.sha256,b.size,b.format)=(u.tenant_id,u.sha256,u.size,u.format)
